paper_title: Direct access to substituted benzo[b]carbazoles through cascade annulation of 2-vinylbenzaldehydes with indoles

knowledge_points.content: A palladium-catalyzed cascade annulation of 2-vinylbenzaldehydes with indoles produces 6-(3-indolyl)benzo[b]carbazoles with high regioselectivity and yields up to 96%.
knowledge_points.evidence: A highly efficient palladium-catalyzed cascade annulation of 2-vinylbenzaldehydes with indoles has been achieved to afford 6-(3-indolyl)- benzo[b]carbazoles under mild conditions in good yield and with excellent regioselectivity.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized catalyst system for synthesizing benzo[b]carbazoles uses 2 mol% of (MeCN)4Pd(OTf)2 in acetonitrile (MeCN) at 60 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: Catalytic loading could be reduced to 2 mol% with maintained 96% yield (entry 14)... best yield of 94% of 3a was obtained with (MeCN)4Pd(OTf)2.

knowledge_points.content: Potassium persulfate (K2S2O8) acts as a superior oxidant compared to AgOAc, Cu(OAc)2, or DDQ for the oxidative aromatization step in benzo[b]carbazole synthesis.
knowledge_points.evidence: The oxidant K2S2O8 proved far superior to AgOAc, Cu(OAc)2, DDQ, and air or O2 (1 atm) (entries 2–4).

knowledge_points.content: Planar benzo[b]carbazole scaffolds are utilized as functional building blocks in organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) and organic field-effect transistors (OFETs) due to their optical and electronic properties.
knowledge_points.evidence: planar benzo[b]carbazole scaffolds demonstrate promising optical and electronic properties, making them attractive as functional building blocks in optoelectronic devices, such as organic light-emitting diodes and organic field effect transistors.

knowledge_points.content: Benzo[b]carbazole end-capped oligothiophenes serve as effective semiconductors in organic field-effect transistors (OFETs).
knowledge_points.evidence: For example, benzo[b]carbazole end-capped oligothiophenes IV have been used as semiconductors in organic field effect transistors.

knowledge_points.content: The synthesis of 6-(3-indolyl)benzo[b]carbazoles via 2-vinylbenzaldehydes tolerates various functional groups including methyl, methoxy, fluoro, chloro, and trifluoromethyl groups.
knowledge_points.evidence: The reaction worked efficiently with 2-vinylbenzaldehydes bearing electron-neutral or -rich functional groups such as Me, MeO, F, Cl and CF3, producing compounds 3b–f in good to excellent yield.

knowledge_points.content: The reaction mechanism for benzo[b]carbazole formation includes a sequence of double indole addition to the carbonyl, 1,4-aryl migration via 5-ipso cyclization, 1,2-hydrogen migration, and final oxidative aromatization.
knowledge_points.evidence: Mechanistic investigations reveal that the reaction proceeds via double addition of indoles, unexpected intramolecular 1,4-aryl and 1,2-hydrogen migrations, and oxidative aromatization.

knowledge_points.content: Single-crystal X-ray diffraction was employed to confirm the precise molecular structure of the substituted benzo[b]carbazole products.
knowledge_points.evidence: The single-crystal X-ray diffraction analysis of 3u further confirmed the structure of the products.

knowledge_points.content: The cascade annulation method represents the first instance of simultaneous functionalization of both the carbonyl and alkenyl groups in a 2-vinylbenzaldehyde synthon.
knowledge_points.evidence: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first example of simultaneous functionalization of both the carbonyl and alkenyl groups in 2-vinylbenzaldehydes.

knowledge_points.content: A kinetic isotope effect (KIE) of 1.1 suggests that C-H bond cleavage is not the rate-determining step in the Pd-catalyzed synthesis of benzo[b]carbazoles.
knowledge_points.evidence: a kinetic isotope effect of 1.1 was obtained from parallel reactions (see the ESI†), suggesting that the C-H bond cleavage is not the rate-determining step in the reaction.
